blurb: JJ Boat Rentals offers rental of custom-built aluminum Raider boats designed for fishing and versatility in northwest fisheries. The boats feature heavy gauge welded construction, premium marine equipment, and are suitable for various fishing adventures. Guests pick up and drop off boats at Aurora Harbor in Juneau, Alaska.
extraNote: Aurora Harbor, Juneau AK 99801. Head down the main ramp, take a right, then third left to the end of the dock; the boat house is on the right.
